Name: SVE Furry Mod - Compatibility Patch (Sophia)
Author: fecferro28
Description:
I have been playing with the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1083]Furry Overhaul Mod[/url]﻿﻿, and decided to download the stardew valley extended mod, but the new NPC Sophie didn't have a furry portrait on nexusmods so I just decided to create one myself. It's not perfect, even because it is the first time that I tried doing something like this, but it is better than anything. I decided to leave it posted here, at least while no one else does something better. So if you are impatient just like me you can use it for now. :P

[u]INSTALLATION INSTRUCTIONS:[/u]

1.Download the file with the 2 pictures: Sophia and sprites
2.Replace these 2 pictures for the new ones in MODS>[SVE] SOPHIA>ASSETS>IMAGE
(I would recommend having a backup just in case)

That's it! Have fun and if u have any suggestions or problems feel free to comment. As I said I've never done anything like this, so any help is wellcome.
